family_reports.body: It destroyed me emotionally and psychologically. It destroyed the innocence of three little girls. It took them away from their families, their friends, their schools and their two brothers. Their grandfather had a stroke while all this was going on and his last wish was to get those girls home. He died, knowing that his granddaughters were in Foster Care being molested by a 40+ year-old man. It has destroyed my daughter emotionally and made her drug use hundred times worse. It has affected every single person in our family.

Lenoir county DSS came into our lives with the notion that they were there to help us rebuild after a brutal and traumatic experience. Instead,they came in and completely ripped my family apart . Slandered my name and character. Caused my kids emotional, mental, and even physical trauma throughout this case . And they have done this unlawfully, illegally, and maliciously.

There were constant theats of making my life miserable if i ever left . However Never in a million years did I ever think with my ex knowing his status of being sterile he would attempt to kidnap my child with the courts help much less get away with it. using the courts to gain coercive control, custody of a child he knew wasn't his. These people have ruined me, my family perspective on fair and equal justice. Left to suffer in silence ,captivity my son physical, mental and psychological trauma from this nightmare will have longterm impact well imto adulthood. This system has destroyed my children bonds , a sense of being whole and our family bond. Causing unnecessary, undeserving stress, Confusion and great distrust with this grave travesty of justice,division of our family causing daily emotional struggles

public_comments.comment_text: On multiple occasions she ignored evidence that the social workers on my case had falsified information against me. She made judgements solely based on her personal opinion of me . She signed an order to have two of my children removed from my moms care and placed in foster homes when my daughter fell off the trampoline and broke her wrist. She claimed it was improper supervision. The next morning cps and police came to my home with a non secured custody order for my 6month old baby girl. The petition was 4 paragraphs long. In court my lawyer was able to completely disprove everything on the petition with pictures, paperwork, questioning the case workers on stand. The judge still ruled against me getting my baby back and she was placed into the same foster as my other two kids. Ignored evidence,. Made judgements based on her opinion and personal vendettas rather than from law and general statutes She did not go by the laws and was unfair and she made her judgments and her decision based on her own opinions instead of evidence in the case and instead of going by statutes and laws. She ordered me to 30 days in jail because I left a detox center early by 1 day,. I was 8 months pregnant and ended up having my daughter while still incarcerated.
